nodes.name: mixed ethanol solution of Fe(NO3)3·9H2O, NiCl2, and MoCl5
Precursor Loading
nodes.procedure: A mixed ethanol solution of Fe(NO3)3·9H2O, NiCl2, and MoCl5 with a specific proportion was prepared and dripped on a suction-filtered CNT film, which was placed on a heating plate at a constant temperature of 60 °C. The precursor solution was continuously added dropwise and the CNT film was kept flipping every 2 minutes to guarantee the uniform coating of the metal precursors.

nodes.name: Laser Drilling
nodes.procedure: The precursor/CNT film was drilled simply with a laser beam owing to the strong light absorption of the CNT film, creating periodic micropores in the film.

nodes.name: Sulfuration and Doping
nodes.procedure: The samples were sulfurized and doped at 400 °C in a tube furnace for 30 minutes, forming Fe-(NiS2/MoS2) on the CNT film, in an atmosphere of 10% H2 and 90% Ar as the carrier gas and sulfur vapor as the precursor gas.

nodes.description: Overall water splitting in 1 M KOH
nodes.source_text: Fe-(NiS₂/MoS₂)/CNT... only low cell voltages of 1.51, 1.67, and 1.73 V are needed to drive the catalyst electrode pair at current densities of 10, 100, and 200 mA cm⁻², respectively... remains very stable during a test of continuous overall water splitting at 10/100/200 mA cm⁻² consecutively, each for 8 hours (24 hours in total)... stable in a long-term test of 264 hours (11 days @ 10 mA cm⁻²)

Fe-(NiS₂/MoS₂)/CNT has a very good HER activity (η₁₀ = 87 mV and η₁₉₀ = 197 mV) vs. RHE... Tafel slope of Fe-(NiS₂/MoS₂)/CNT (53 mV dec⁻¹)... Cdl value of Fe-(NiS₂/MoS₂)/CNT reaches as high as 227.2 mF cm⁻²... electron transfer resistance is small (~1.1 Ω)
the overpotentials of Fe-(NiS₂/MoS₂)/CNT... for the OER are 234 mV vs. RHE at a current density of 10 mA cm⁻² in 1 M KOH. The Tafel slope of Fe-(NiS₂/MoS₂)/CNT (64 mV dec⁻¹)

In 0.5 M H₂SO₄, the overpotential of Fe-(NiS₂/MoS₂)/CNT (98 mV) at a current density of 10 mA cm⁻². The calculated Tafel slopes... 54 mV dec⁻¹... Cdl value 261.8 mF cm⁻²... charge transfer resistance (~0.9 Ω)
Fe-(NiS₂/MoS₂)/CNT still exhibits a reasonably good HER activity η₁₀ = 127 mV... The Tafel slopes of 68 mV dec⁻¹... Cdl value... 97.4 mF cm⁻²... charge transfer resistance (~14 Ω)

stability.value: stable across 1 M KOH, 0.5 M H₂SO₄, 1 M PBS

nodes.source_text: Fe-(NiS₂/MoS₂)/CNT working very stably during a test of continuous HER at 10/100/200 mA cm⁻² consecutively, each for 8 hours... electrodes also remain stable for 168 hours (7 days @ 10 mA cm⁻²) under acidic and neutral conditions

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD shows peaks indexed to NiS₂ (JPCDS no. 11-0099) and MoS₂ (JPCDS no. 37-1492) with CNT peak at 26°; no FeS₂ peaks indicating Fe doping; (002) MoS₂ and (311) NiS₂ peaks shift to higher 2θ after Fe doping.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The crystalline structures of the samples were characterized by X-ray diffraction (XRD), as shown in Fig. 2a. In addition to the peak at around 26° belonging to CNTs, other peaks are well indexed to NiS₂ (JPCDS no. 11-0099) and MoS₂ (JPCDS no. 37-1492)...

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni 2p peaks at 872.1 eV (2p1/2) and 854.7 eV (2p3/2) for Ni²⁺ blueshift after NiS2/MoS2 compositing and further after Fe doping indicating Ni loses electrons; Mo 3d peaks at 232.6 eV (3d3/2), 229.5 eV (3d5/2) for Mo⁴⁺ and S 2s at 226.4 eV redshift ~0.3 eV and 0.1 eV indicating electron transfer from NiS2 to MoS2 enhanced by Fe doping; S 2p peaks at 163.9/162.5 eV (S₂²⁻) and 163.3/162.1 eV (S²⁻) for low coordination S and metal-S bonds; Fe 2p shows Fe-S bonds at 708.5 eV.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As for Ni 2p in Fig. 2c, two distinct peaks at 872.1 and 854.7 eV are attributed to Ni 2p1/2 and Ni 2p3/2... Compared with those in pure NiS2/CNT, the Ni 2p peaks blueshift when forming an undoped NiS2/MoS2/CNT composite and further blueshift after Fe doping... For Mo 3d shown in Fig. 2d, the two peaks at 232.6 and 229.5 eV correspond to Mo 3d3/2 and Mo 3d5/2... both Mo 3d and S 2s peaks have slightly red-shifted in Fe-(NiS2/MoS2)/CNT by about 0.3 and 0.1 eV... Fig. S4b† shows Fe 2p peaks containing Fe 2p1/2, Fe 2p3/2 and Fe–S bonds at 722.0, 713.3, and 708.5 eV.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM shows CNT film rough surface with laser-drilled micropores of ~40 μm diameter, 800 μm pitch; nanoﬂakes dispersed and embedded in CNT ﬁlm increasing surface roughness.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The morphologies of the as-grown samples were characterized by scanning electron microscopy (SEM), as shown in Fig. 3a–c. The CNT ﬁlm has a rough surface that provides a large surface area. Each micro-pore drilled with a laser is about 40 μm in diameter with a pitch of 800 μm.

nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in high resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) images (Fig. 3d–g), randomly orientated MoS₂ and NiS₂ domains are coated on the CNT ﬁlm... The lattice fringe of 0.62 nm belongs to the MoS₂ (002) crystal plane (Fig. 3e), and the lattice distances of 0.28 nm and 0.32 nm belong to the (200) and (111) crystal planes of NiS₂.
